meta.name: google-image-search
meta.description: Search and download images via Google Custom Search API with LLM-powered selection. This skill should be used when finding images for articles, presentations, research documents, or enriching Obsidian notes with relevant visuals. Supports simple queries, batch processing from JSON config, automatic config generation from terms, and full note enrichment with automatic image insertion below headings.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 AI 筛选图片，自动搜索下载到文档中
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为文档快速找到相关图片
copy.tagline_en: Search and download relevant images with AI-powered selection
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to find and insert relevant images into your documents or notes

howto.what: Claude 能够根据你的需求，使用 Google 搜索并下载相关图片，并自动选出最合适的一张。它还支持一次搜索多个主题、从笔记中提取关键词并插入图片。
howto.when: 当你需要为文章、演示、研究文档找图片，或者希望为 Obsidian 笔记自动配图时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索一张脑机接口设备的图片并下载。
say.note: Claude 会搜索并下载最合适的图片。

say.text: 根据这份研究笔记，为每个小节配一张图。
say.note: Claude 会提取关键术语，搜索后插入图片。

say.text: 批量搜索这几个主题的最新图片：量子计算、人工智能、区块链。
say.note: Claude 会生成配置并逐一下载。

howto.what_en: Claude can search and download images from Google Custom Search, with smart selection of the best one. It supports single queries, batch processing, auto-generating configs from terms, and enriching Obsidian notes by extracting key terms and inserting images.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need images for articles, presentations, research, or enriching Obsidian notes, or when you explicitly ask to search or download images.

say_en.text: Find and download an image of a brain-computer interface device.
say_en.note: Claude will search and download the best image.

say_en.text: Enrich this research note with relevant images for each section.
say_en.note: Claude will extract key terms and insert images.

say_en.text: Batch search images for these topics: quantum computing, AI, blockchain.
say_en.note: Claude will generate configs and download images for each.
